newsitem.title: UK: Moody's confirms Swiss Bank, units ratings.
newsitem.headline: Moody's confirms Swiss Bank, units ratings.

text.p: Moody's Investors Services said on Wednesday it confirmed the AA1 ratings of Swiss Bank Corp and its guaranteed subsidiaries.

"This confirmation follows SBC's public announcement of several upcoming operational initiatives in its domestic division, a change in credit risk accounting and accelerated write-offs of the real estate portfolio which will result in a net loss for the group of over 1.9 billion Swiss francs at year-end 1996," Moody's said in a statement.

In confirming the ratings, Moody's noted that this significant loss - which is the result of a change in accounting policies regarding loan loss provisions as well as of the acceleration of loss recognition on commercial real estate - does not reflect a deterioration in the group's true earning power and economic capitalisation.

Moody's said SBC's profitability remains influenced by the low profitability of its domestic operation as well as by a gradual recognition of the asset quality deterioration in a difficult economic environment.

"The restructuring of domestic operations, the accounting change in provisioning policies and the real estate write down - should in time impact favorably the group's net profitability and reduce the relatively high volatility of its earnings," Moody's said.

The rating agency added that SBC's domestic asset quality outlook remains an on-going credit concern. Further significant credit expenses could occur in the future, thus potentially affecting the group's fundamentals, it said.
Ratings for the following units were also confirmed.
Swiss Bank Corporation, Swiss Bank Corporation, Chicago Branch, Swiss Bank Corporation, Jersey Branch, Swiss Bank Corporation, New-York Branch.
SBC (Sydney Limited), SBC Finance (Cayman Islands) Ltd., SBC Australia Ltd., Swiss Bank Corporation Finance (Delaware) Inc.
